Class MessageInspect

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.MessageInspect
public class MessageInspect extends Object
The MessageInspect is a read-only view of one stored message. The object stores the sequence number, which is the message id that locates the frame. The object stores the RouxId, the role, the time, and the token count. The object stores the frame type, the page id, the offset, and the length. The object stores the residency word taken before the bytes are read. Residency is HOT, RESIDENT, or SPILLED. The object stores whether the payload checksum matched. The checksum is the CRC32C value stored on the frame. The object stores the message text. A null residency is stored as an empty string. A null text is stored as an empty string. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MessageInspect roux-v1.md

  • Constructor Details

    • MessageInspect

      public MessageInspect(long seq, RouxId rouxId, byte role, long timestampEpochMs, int tokenCount, byte type, int pageId, int offset, int length, String residency, boolean crcOk, String text)
      The constructor stores the inspect fields for one message. A null residency is stored as an empty string. A null text is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      seq - The sequence number is the message id that locates the frame.
      rouxId - The identity is the RouxId.
      role - The role is a byte from Role.
      timestampEpochMs - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      type - The type is a byte from FrameType.
      pageId - The page id is the page that holds the frame.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the frame in that page.
      length - The length is the frame size in bytes.
      residency - The residency is HOT, RESIDENT, or SPILLED.
      crcOk - The flag is true when the payload checksum matched.
      text - The text is the message body, or an empty string.
